title: Top K Frequent Words
description:
Return the `k` most frequent words from a list. Sort by descending frequency; when frequencies tie, sort alphabetically. Words are case-sensitive. If `k` is zero or negative, return an empty list.

For example, `top_k_frequent_words(["pear", "fig", "pear", "fig", "plum"], 2)` returns `["fig", "pear"]` because the two most common words tie and alphabetical order breaks the tie.

solution.explanation: Count each word, then sort unique words by descending count and alphabetical order. The tuple key makes the tie-break explicit. Slice the ordered list to return at most k words.
